tool_uses.command: ls -a; cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null; cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls tmp 2>/dev/null; git check-ignore -v tmp/x.log

mkdir -p tmp && grep -qx 'tmp/' .git/info/exclude || echo 'tmp/' >> .git/info/exclude
LOG=tmp/test-run-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).log
{ echo "Command: python3 -m pytest -v"; echo "Started: $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; echo "Commit: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"; echo "-----"; } > $LOG
start=$(date +%s.%N)
python3 -m pytest -v -p no:cacheprovider >> $LOG 2>&1; rc=$?
end=$(date +%s.%N)
{ echo "-----"; echo "Exit code: $rc"; printf "Wall time: %.2f s\n" $(echo "$end - $start" | bc); echo "Finished: $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; } >> $LOG
echo $PWD/$LOG; cat $LOG; git status --short

rm -f tmp/test-run-*.log
LOG=tmp/test-run-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).log
{ echo "Command: python3 -m unittest discover -v"; echo "Started: $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; echo "Commit: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"; echo "-----"; } > $LOG
start=$(date +%s.%N)
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -v >> $LOG 2>&1; rc=$?
end=$(date +%s.%N)
{ echo "-----"; echo "Exit code: $rc"; printf "Wall time: %.2f s\n" $(echo "$end - $start" | bc); echo "Finished: $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; } >> $LOG
echo $PWD/$LOG; cat $LOG; echo "--- git status:"; git status --short; git check-ignore -v $LOG

final_text:
The test run passed (1 test, OK, exit code 0). I didn't change any code.

**Log:** `<workspace>/tmp/test-run-20261102-195256.log`

- **Contents:** the command, commit (`e23ed56`), the full verbose output, exit code, start and finish times, and wall time. Wall time was under 0.01 s.
- **Runner:** `pytest` isn't installed here, so I used `python3 -m unittest discover -v`. The tests are plain `unittest`, so this runs them correctly. My first attempt with pytest failed. I deleted that log so it doesn't confuse the PR.
- **Not tracked:** I added `tmp/` to `.git/info/exclude`, which is local to your clone and not committed. `git status` is clean, and `git check-ignore` confirms the log is ignored.
